result.title: BUMP: Brief Unexpected Mid-Interpolation Peak
result.summary: We identify an intriguing phenomenon when linearly interpolating between permutation-aligned neural networks: test accuracy briefly improves near the interpolation endpoints before dropping toward the midpoint, which we term BUMP (Brief Unexpected Mid-interpolation Peak). We observe that BUMP appears consistently across datasets, architectures, training regimes, and remains robust under substantial perturbations such as early checkpoints and extreme pruning. Moreover, controlled ablations suggest that it cannot be attributed to trivial regularization effects. While similar near-endpoint gains are visible in prior interpolation plots, they have not been explicitly documented or systematically and thoroughly analyzed. Leveraging this effect, we propose a simple, novel ensembling scheme: weight-prediction mixed ensembling that combines weight mixing with prediction-space mixing. Across our experiments, the resulting ensembling method consistently outperforms standard logit ensembling in test accuracy and yields improved calibration trade-off, highlighting complementary benefits of weight- and prediction-space mixing.

AI.brief_summary: 论文报告了在置换对齐网络间线性插值时，测试精度在接近端点处短暂回升、随后降至中点的现象（BUMP），并在多数据集、架构与训练设置下验证其稳健性；同时据此提出结合权重混合与预测空间混合的集成方案，在精度与校准权衡上优于标准 logit 集成。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「权重空间混合＋预测空间混合」的组合思路可供核查是否能类比用于合并多条 latent 推理轨迹或多个 latent 假设，并影响输出校准；但论文本身不涉及视觉推理或多模态内部状态，联系较弱。
